title: A Sea Otter Has a Million Hairs in One Square Inch
thumbnail_text: A million hairs per square inch

scenes.text: A sea otter has a million hairs in one square inch.
Your whole head has about one hundred thousand.
That's the densest fur on Earth. A patch the size of a stamp holds ten heads worth of hair.
It needs every strand. Sea otters have no blubber, and the Pacific is freezing.
The fur keeps water out. To stay warm, the otter eats a quarter of its body weight every day.
So that cute fluffy face is a survival suit. A million hairs per square inch.

description:
A sea otter has a million hairs in one square inch. Your whole head has about 100,000.
Sea otters have the densest fur of any animal, up to a million hairs per square inch, because unlike whales and seals they have no blubber. The fur keeps cold water off the skin, and they eat about 25 percent of their body weight every day to stay warm.
What's the fluffiest animal you've ever seen in real life?
first_comment: Bonus: a sea otter mum grooms her pup's fur for about three months, until it can trap enough air to float on its own. What's the fluffiest animal you've ever seen in real life?
